title: Count the boxes in a tree
hints: Use the same shape as `eval`: a `match` with one case for `Num`, one for `Add` and one for `Mul`.
A `Num` is one box. An `Add` is one box plus all the boxes on its left side plus all the boxes on its right side.
`| Num _ -> 1 | Add (a, b) -> 1 + size a + size b | Mul (a, b) -> 1 + size a + size b`
explain: The reference matches on the kind: `Num _ -> 1`, and both `Add (a, b)` and `Mul (a, b)` give `1 + size a + size b`. It has the same shape as `eval`. Only what each case does with the answers from the smaller trees is different.
